item.title: The Zero Node
item.description: Six seconds of window, four times a day. He spent one of them on you. Transmission one of ten. SLIP THREE is a work of fiction and an alternate reality game. All characters, vessels, organisations, agencies, callsigns, coordinates, dates and frequencies are invented. It is not a real disclosure, not a real distress broadcast, and no real person, company or public body is depicted or accused.
